notes: *whatsoever* is read as one rendering of כְּ plus כֹּל, with the article unrepresented because the ASV writes none of the determiners rule 41 lists for it (rule 29's closing sentence). The materially different alternative — fusing כֹּל with the substantival article, on the model of rule 35's כֹּל אֲשֶׁר → *whatsoever*, and leaving the כְּ unrepresented under rule 40 — remains defensible and is recorded here rather than adopted.
*unto thee* divides between the fused בְּעֵינֵי and the suffix, no English word writing the lexeme of *eyes* (rule 30's כְּפִיךָ precedent).
*seemeth* is the construction's linking verb and joins the predicate adjective's unit (rule 20); נָא takes the whole entreaty formula *we pray thee*, headed on *pray* (rule 30).
